note: Backfilled point-in-time direction calls scored against known outcomes over a FIXED window anchored at 15 August 2026, closing before the model went live on 22 August, so no backtest row sits inside the live window. Not a live public record; the live scoreboard is reported separately and is never averaged with this. FX is included as of 3 September 2026: the seven pairs previously had no backtest at all. The grid was also rebuilt so each asset's windows are non-overlapping by construction. That rebuild is why commodities now reads 54% rather than the 62% published earlier: the old figure was inflated by windows that overlapped their neighbours. None of the three classes is distinguishable from a coin flip once the interval is computed on the number of dates rather than the number of calls, which is the honest unit because every asset in a class is called on the same day and they move together.
